entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet a while ago and I'm just so confused by the website. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, let me see... yes, it's VF-8675309.

Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 54 days ago. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

A fault? Oh, no, I don't think so. It's just... the color. It looked different online. My partner says it clashes terribly with my bike. The box is unopened, I promise. I never even took it out. I just don't understand the rules. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I understand completely, sometimes the color just isn't right in person. Let me just pull up our policy for you.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.

Not at all. I see here that you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. Since the box is unopened, we can definitely process that return for you. We take safety very seriously, so we couldn't take back a used helmet, but an unused one is perfectly fine.
Oh, really? That's a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with it. Thank you!

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return process in our system. I am sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at your local post office. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for making it so simple, Alex.
Happy to help. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
